title: Understanding a hold as circumstances change
meaning: Stepwise comparison can reveal attachment to a shared explanation when changed conditions bring its limits into view.
text: Changing conditions can sometimes reveal how tightly you held an explanation. The Emperor in the physical position of Ajna suggests comparing a version’s foundations and particular observations stepwise. The Devil in energy supports constructive examination of its appeal: what holds attention and limits choice. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions responds with a shifting picture. Seeing the question differently may feel alternately interesting and unfamiliar.

For example, you think a creative idea together is interesting only if it could surprise people you know. Comparing a few trials reveals how strongly the assessment changes with the audience you imagine. **A change the explanation cannot account for can reveal what grips you.** Interest in the material itself becomes distinguishable from pleasure in an imagined response. The new picture can enliven discussion. A specific question appears: what remains fascinating if nobody else sees the work for now? Different answers can refine your shared view.

The risk is continuing to seek an imagined audience that will finally confirm the idea’s value. The prospective viewer changes while the explanation’s dependence remains. Interest in its hold can reveal this circle. Concrete material may become a separate foundation for assessment. Shifting impressions then leave room for an observation through which both people can understand what the examination actually revealed.
